description: Sends a burst's email configuration now: one email to its recipients with each variant it selects. Building it outlasts the request, so it goes out after the answer. Send a test with sendBurstEmailConfigTest first to check how it looks. Only the burst's owner and admins may. Sends have a low rate limit. From an AI client, the send only asks the user to confirm it in Rollstack: it answers `confirmation-required` and runs once they confirm.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

configId.description: The email configuration, by its `id` from `listBurstEmailConfigs`.

id.description: The burst to act on, by its `id` from `listBursts`. You can also copy it from the burst's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/collections/`.

name: sendBurstEmailConfig
title: Send burst email configuration
